# ModelMeter

> ModelMeter groups billed USD costs from a normalized CSV and calculates cost per 1,000 requests and an explicitly assumed monthly spending pace.

Free browser tools. Paid features are not available.

No live provider connection, price database, automatic savings or future-bill prediction. Enter already-billed USD costs; missing expenses stay missing. Paid subscriptions are unavailable.
